tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje dmar po rlung sgrub kyi zhal gdams rnams bzhugs so//

'jam dpal gshin rje shor sang nyi ma khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra mnan gshin rje rlung sgrub kyi man ngag gab cing sbas pa rnams 'dir bstan pa la/ liṅga 'bri ba'i tshe/ snga dgra lag gis bdar ba sogs dmod pa rnams liṅga la bcer nas bri/ de'i phyir liṅga'i g.yas su sbrul dkar po dang g.yon du sbrul nag po gnyis mgo mjug mdud pa bri/ sbrul gyi phyir sngags ring bri/ de'i phyir dzaḥnan khram gsum bris kyang legs pa yin/ yang gzhung ltar dmod pa dang sngags ring gnyis ka sbrul gyi nang du bri/ sbrul gyi phyir dzaḥnan khram gsum 'bri ba de ga byas kyang nyan pa yin/ yang liṅga'i mgor sbrul mgo gnyis mdud nas bsnol ba'i sbrul gnyis kyi mchu rtse'u phan za ba/ mjug ma gnyis rkang zhabs su mdud nas mjug rtse gnyis 'og sgo gnyis su zug pa bri/ sbrul gyi phyi rol tu sngags ring gi mjug tu snga dgra lag gis bdar ba sogs dmod pa rnams btags la bri/ de'i phyir rol dzaḥnan khram gsum gyis bskor yang nyan pa yin no/ liṅga'i sngags dmod sbrul gi phyi nang lugs gsum po gang ltar bris kyang lo dang zla ba sogs liṅga'i mgo dang g.yas g.yon 'og tu 'bri ba rnams ni 'gyur med yin no/ yang ban sngags la ngag gnon byed na gzhan rnams gzhung ltar la liṅga lce phyir drangs/ brang bkab pa'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i lte bar dzaḥnṛ za/ de mthar dgra bo che ge mo'i ngag s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ nan/ oṃ khri waṃ hūm̐ wāka suṃ nan/ zhes phyir bstan du bri/ rdo rje'i mtshams bzhir dgra bo che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya s+t+waṃ bha ya rbad nan chings/ zhes pa tshar re bri/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyi rol lce steng du bla 'gugs pa'i sngags dang dmod pa rnams bri| gzhan liṅga'i gnas yig dang sngags dang dmod pa sbrul la sogs pa thams cad gzhung dang zhal gdams su bshad pa lugs gsum po gang rung 'bri ba yin no/

byug pa'i rdzas khrag sna gang 'dzoms la gri khrag mdze khrag med na dug sna gang 'dzoms la btsan dug nag po dang thang phrom dkar nag med du mi rung*/ sa sna gang 'dzoms la mchod rten zhig po'i sa/ lha khang zhig po'i rdo'am sa/ ri nyil ba'i sa med du mi rung ngo*// khyad par ngag mnan la phug ron sgo nga'i ser thigs/ lkugs pa'i khrag dang rtug gcin la sogs pa byugs/ gang la'ang dgra'i zag rdzas byug na shin tu myur ba yin/ lar dgra du yod pa'i ming rus rnams liṅga gcig rang la 'bri chog pa yin/ yang rus ma shes na dpral bar dzaḥ dgra mang po la byed na dpral bar sha trūṃ dgra bo dzaḥ ming ma shes na snying khar dgra bo nṛ mā ra kha ge hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes 'bri chog /liṅga 'bri ba'i snag tsha la dug dang khrag sna bsre/ thun rdzas ni yungs kar| yungs nag /ri chen po'i rbab rdo/ g.yer ma lan tshwa bslad med rnams bsres la bya'o// lha dbye'i rdzas dud ni drag po mngon spyod kyi gzhung gzhan nas gsungs pa ltar ram/ yang na dgra de ga'i pha mes kyi thod pa rnyed na mchog /de ma rnyed na ban sngags bon po la mon nam rab chad kyi thod pa/ dgra bo spyi la khyi thod/ 'byung po spyi la phag thod/ mi skya kher ded la wa thod/ de thams cad ma 'dzom na glang gi rwa me chus ma phog pa skyes pa la g.yas dang*/ bud med la g.yon pa byas kyang nyan pa yin no/ thod pa byed na thod pa gang byed kyang brad bdar legs par byas la/ spyi bor spyi dgra thog tu bab pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ dpral bar rgan pa'i rgan sri langs pa thams cad= gdong par gzhon pa'i gzhon sri= byis pa'i chung sri= 'gram pa g.yas la skyes pa pho'i pho sri= 'gram pa g.yon la za ma mo'i sri langs pa = mche ba'am smin mtshams su/ dar ma'i dar sri= rna ltag gnyis su phung sri dang god sri= ya rkan la mi kha dang smra mchu ngan pa langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ ces pa rnams bri/

thod pa sogs su liṅga bcug zin nas mi kha'i rdzas kyis bkang*/ de'i khar thun rdzas sngags btab pa'ang blugs la khengs par bya'o// liṅga zhing lpags sam ro ras kyis dril/ shi yug gi skras bcings nas snod du ma bcug gong der/ rang la mi ldog phar la thebs pa 'khor lo phung bshig stong ldar ni liṅga rang 'thag skyu mig nas yas nas mar lan bdun drangs shing*/ ngag tu dgra bo che ge mo rbad rmugs nṛ rbad rbud ya/ zhes brgya'am stong sogs bzlas pas dgra phye mar song bar bsam/ las 'gyang mi srid pa'i man ngag ni/ phyi sgo'i ma them 'og tu liṅga lan bdun nang nas phyir drangs shing*/ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog nṛ laṃ nan mā ra ya rbad nan/ zhes bzla/ rang la slar mi ldog pa'i gnad rang gi rkang pa gnyis la liṅga phyi skor gsum bya/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ya mā ri bh+yo dgra bo che ge mo sha trūṃ rbad rbud sod nan/ zhes bzla/ de ma thag thod pa sogs su bcug byad chas zin nas lcags snod du bzhag pa la/ rang nyid skor ba phyi kha log pa bdun bya zhing sngags de nyid bzla/ mnan nas phyis mi ldang ba'i man ngag ni/ ro g.yam la rgya gram dang ri rab gsum laṃ bris pas mnan cing*/ laṃ las ri rab bskyed la mnan par bsam/ de steng sāts+tsha don grub gyi pho brang bskyed pas mnan la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma kiṃ kaṃ dgra bgegs sarba trig nan rbad nan bhi na tsit+ta rbad nan/ laṃ nan nan/ zhes brgya'am stong sogs bzlas pa gal che'o// mnan pa'i sa bru ba'i tshad ni khru gang yan chad phan med gnod med sa ro yin/ de nas mar la sor chen bcu dgu brus pa'i sa ni sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i gnas yin pas der mnan no// de'i tshe'ang gshin rje nag po'i sngags rgyud kyi le'u drug par/ sa snyi don gsal rtags shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ mnan pa'i sa bru ba'i tshe snyi 'bol le ba dang mnan sa dong du 'jug dus don po yid la gsal ba byung na mnan pa 'grub pa'i rtags yin no// yang mnan pa'i dus ni rgyud de nyid las/

nyi shu dgu'am gnam stong gi// skya rengs 'char ba dus shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ mnan pa byed pa'i dus ni nyer dgu'am gnam stong gi skya rengs 'char ba dang mnan pa byed pa dus mtshungs pa nges par gal che ba yin no// dgra thub pa'i rtags ni rang nyid rdzong bzung ba/ go khrab gyon pa/ mtshon cha thogs pa/ dar 'phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa/ g.yag bsad pa/ bcings pa/ brdung ba/ sho dang*/ cho lo dang*/ mig mangs la sogs pa brtses pas rang rgyal ba/ g.yul 'khrugs pas rang rgyal ba sogs rmis na rang gis rgyal kha thob pa'i rtags yin no// chos skyong srung ma la gsol mchod bya zhing phrin las rgyab rten 'chol ba dang*/ nang rtags gsal ba gal che'o// zhal shes yin no// zab zab// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya: yang ban sngags bon po sogs mthu byed dang nan ltar 'gras na/ rū pa lce phyung ba'i dbus su rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i lte bar dza ཿnṛ za/ de'i mthar/ nṛ mā ra ya baṃ/ nṛ dzaḥraṃ/ zhes bri/ lce rtsa'i ngos la/ wāka s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ dgra bo che ge ban sngags dang 'gras na kho'i gsang mtshan gang yin de nyid 'bri/ dngos ming mi bri'o// mo'i ngag gi rnam par shes pa mā ra ya nan brub/ ces bri/ rgya gram gyi mtha' skor lce'i steng du/ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la hur thuṃ rbad/ snying la sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad/ dbugs la thuṃ ril rbad/ yid la laṃ rmug rbad/ mā ra ya sod ces sngags mgo nang bstan du bri/ lce'i phyi rol khong pa'i nang du bla 'gugs sngags bris/ rū pa'i phyir sngags ring gi gsham du/ dgra bo che ge mo'i lus kyi rnam par shes pa thun sod rbad/ ngag gi rnam par shes pa raṃ rbad/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yaṃ rbad/ mig gi rnam par shes pa khaṃ rbad/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa suṃ rbad/ sna'i rnam par shes pa laṃ rbad/ lce'i rnam par shes pa dzaḥrbad/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa laṃ rmug nyag rbad nan/ dgra bo che ge mo'i lus hur thuṃ rbad/

ngag s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ yid rmug raṃ hūm̐ nan/ rtsa rus srog rtsa la spring spring nan/ bla tshe dbugs la rbad rbad nan/ tsit+ta shag shag /gtubs gtubs/ ling ling*/ myog myog |baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad nan/ oṃ bha de sha ya bha de sha ya/ ha hra s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ nan/ zhes btags la bri/ dmod pa dang sbrul dang dzaḥnan liṅga'i gnas yig rnams dang*/ khram sogs gzhung ltar 'bri ba yin no// gzhan rdzas la sogs pa thams kyang gzhung kho na ltar bya'o/ yang 'di nyid mkhan po nang 'gras na sngags ring gi mjug tu/ e mā ra ya phaṭa rbad/ dgra bo byad ma che ge mo'i rigs sngags dang dmod pa nṛ dzaḥrbad nan/ s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ nan/ kā ya rbad/ thuṃ ril thuṃ ril rbud/ wāka nan rbad/ thuṃ ril thuṃ ril rbud/ tsit+ta rbad/ thuṃ ril thuṃ ril rbud/ swād swād rbad nan/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ byad ma che ge mo'i rigs sngags rbod gtong nus mthu nṛ dzaḥs+t+waṃ bha ya nan chings brub zlog sod ya/ zhes sngags ring gi mjug tu bris bzlas gnyis ka bya/ gzhan thams cad gong gi mthu byed dang 'gras pa'i skabs kho na ltar bya/ nang 'gras 'di dang gong gi mthu byed 'gras pa'i skabs gnyis kyi mnan pa ni rab byad ma de rang gi mal 'og gam/ lha rten 'og /'bring kho'i them rtsa'am 'gram/ tha na'ang kho rang gang du gnas pa de phyogs su mnan pa yin no// yang shor sang nyi ma khros pa'i gzhung du gshin rje dmar po'i rlung sgrub rigs gcig la/ rang gshin rje dmar po'i las byang du gsal ba ltar bsgoms pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su yum rang dang 'dra ba re re/ mdun du'ang las gshin rang dang 'dra ba gcig |de gsum ga zhal gdangs ljags brkyangs nas rang gi sngags bgrang ba'i rogs byed pa/ lha bzhi gas sngags bgrangs pas brub khung nang gi dgra bo'i srog snying gi dwangs ma yar gzhibs| mdangs phrogs/ dgra bo thal bar brlags/ rang 'dra'i 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pa dang rang gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer spros/

bgegs gang dmigs rang dbang med par la las mdun nas khrid/ la las rgyab nas ded/ snying dkar nag mtshams nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgo la tho ba dang dgra stas bsnun/ kho'i klad pa dang tshe bcud thams cad kha nas lhud kyis bskyugs nas bdag la thim/ kho sgye stong pa ltar lheb lheb gyur nas dngangs skrag 'dar zhing cho nge 'don bzhin par brub khung nang gi liṅga la sib sib thim par bsam/ kho'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram las me 'bar zhing g.yas su 'khor zhing klad khrag dkrugs shing gtor/ zhabs su g.yung drung gcig g.yon du 'khor nas sha khrag dmar tha ra ra btang*/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyis thob sha hab sha byas nas rdul tsam yang ma lus pa zos par bsam gsungs pa 'di rnams kyang spro na byas pas shin tu legs par 'dug go// yang bsad pa'i dus thun drug tu thun 'phen pa'i tshe/ brub khung du dgra bo dngos su gsal ba las/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis mig 'bur tshugs su blta/ pus mo g.yas gyen du bslang*/ g.yon sa la phab/ lag g.yon phreng ba bgrang g.yas pas thun 'phang ngo*/ yang mnan pa'i dus mchod rten dbu rtse med pa zhig gi bum par/ lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba sogs nas/ rbad sod nan chings brub kyi bar bris pa bcug pas liṅga'i steng du gnon par gsungs pa'ang 'dug pa spro na byed chog pa yin no// de ltar gshin rje dmar po'i rlung sgrub kyi zhal shes gab sbas rnams rang nyid brjed par 'jigs pa dang*/ dam ldan gyi slob ma la phan pa'i blos dus mtha'i sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes/ rang lo zhe dgu pa chu lug dbo zla'i dus tshes la pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa yin gyi/ gzhan rnams la rlung sgrub gzhung dang las byang byin yang zhal gdams 'di mi sbyin la/ cis kyang zhal gdams 'di'ang sbyin dgos byung na nang 'gras kyi zhal shes de re re tsam las mi spel ba dam tshig yin no// nang 'gras kyi zhal shes 'di mang po la spel na gshin rje dmar po'i bka'i chad pa drag po thog ltar phob cig

/sa ma ya hoḥ kha thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya: yang zhal gdams su dgra sri spyir mnan pa rta bong khyi sogs long ga can gyi khrag gis liṅga bri/ srog la byed na gri khrag phag khrag dug sna sbyar bas bri/ mdze gtong na mdze khrag gis bri/ mnan pa'i sa ni/ mdze grir gsod na shing sdong skam po dang zam rngu la mnan/ gri 'thab tu gsod na lung gsum 'dus pa'i sa sna dang brag sna gsum sna/ brag seng ge 'dra ba/ stag 'dra ba'i kha/ spre'u 'dra ba'i lag pa/ byi la 'dra ba'i mchu/ sbar mo'i gdengs pa 'dra ba'i sna la gtad/ 'gugs pa'i dus su rkyang su byung na rgyal rigs/ ri dwags gzhan rje rigs/ sems can sna tshogs dmangs rigs/ g.yag ni rigs gdug pa can/ ra dang lug ni rigs kha 'thor ba| mdzo dang drel ni ban+de/ 'ug pa ni bon po khug rtags yin/ dgra dngos bzung bkyigs sogs byed pa'ang 'byung ngo*// yang mi bsad pa dang*/ sems can bsad pa dang*/ shing bcad pa sogs byung na bsad rtags yin/ bshas pa rmis na dgra la na tsha 'byung ngo*// sha ba rta g.yag ra lug sogs// bshas bsad snying phyung btsos dang bsregs// dngos su sde brgyad rnams kyis zos// de 'dra rmis na bsad rtags yin/ /zhing rmos khal bkal ri nyil dang*/ /tha ba rko dang chu dar chags// pha bong bzung bas zlog dmigs nas// de nas mnan pa'i las bya'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang bdun phrag gcig gnyis tsam bsgrubs pas rtags ma byung na gnad la dal dbab cing lan chags mjal ba sogs kiṃ kaṃ chen mo'i gzhung ltar bya'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
